Rita (People Ops): quick one  Jun is starting Mon but is in another state for 2 weeks. Their state ID renewal is pending. Can we still do I-9 Day 1?
Omar (HR): yes. For remote hires use either a) live video I-9 with acceptable doc combo (SSN card + temporary DMV receipt) or b) authorized rep. We must capture screenshots and log doc types.
Jun (New Hire): I can do a Zoom at 9am PT tomorrow. I have the DMV receipt and SSN card scans.
Rita (People Ops): perfect. short script: confirm full name/DOB, show each doc to camera, witness takes timestamped screenshot, upload scans to secure intake.
ScreenCheck Bot: background check status: CONSENT_RECEIVED (1798000030). Vendor ETA: 48-72h; fingerprint backlog possible.
IT Service: we'll image the laptop Day 1 and provision standard access. No admin/privileged groups until BG cleared.
Omar (HR): if BG delayed, mark hire as contingent and restrict sensitive systems. Benefits enrollment and payroll proceed with start date.
Jun (New Hire): I'll be on Zoom 9am PT and uploaded scans. Thanks!
Rita (People Ops): I'll join the Zoom to witness and attach screenshots to the HR record. Closing actions: 1) Zoom witness 2) upload scans 3) monitor BG vendor.
